title: Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage: Daily Coinsurance Rate by Year of Service for Resident Charges
content:
**Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage — daily rate for the resident coinsurance charge.** The daily rate the resident coinsurance charge applies follows the calendar year in which the charged block's days were furnished: a charged block whose last service date falls in 2025 is charged at 209.50 a day, a charged block whose last service date falls in 2024 at 204.00 a day, and any other charged block at 217.00 a day.

The year is read from the last service date on the charged block's booked-days entry in the episode's Medicare billing history — not from the date anything is posted and not from the admission date.

| Last service date of the charged block | Daily rate for the resident coinsurance charge |
|---|---|
| Falls in calendar year 2025 | 209.50 |
| Falls in calendar year 2024 | 204.00 |
| Falls in any other year | 217.00 |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A charged block whose last service date is 30 April 2025 takes 209.50 a day.
- A charged block whose last service date is 28 February 2026 takes 217.00 a day.
- A charged block whose last service date is 31 December 2024 takes 204.00 a day; one ending on 1 January 2025 takes 209.50.

The rate is the same for every day the resident coinsurance charge counts in that charged block.
